title: DimensionalRPG2: NEW HORIZON
description:
This mod is the sequel to dimensionalRPG
adds new armor materials, weapons, and tools
and multiple dimensions
New updates coming soon
body:
💬 Join our Discord Community!
👉 https://discord.gg/P3qcxc8jHZ

Welcome to DimensionalRPG: New Horizon — an ambitious Minecraft mod packed with new content, weapons, armor, dimensions, and adventures!

On our official Discord server, you can:
🧠 Ask for help with your mods or ideas
🎨 Showcase your creations and get feedback
🤝 Collaborate with other modders and artists
👀 Get exclusive sneak peeks and chat with other players

Join us and become part of a growing community of creators and players passionate about Minecraft modding!

🌌⚔️ DimensionalRPG 2: NEW HORIZON ⚔️🌌

🚀 A new era of Minecraft has begun!
This is the second generation of the DimensionalRPG saga 💎✨ — an epic RPG expansion that will take your world to a level never seen before!

⚡ MAIN FEATURES

🌍 7 New Dimensions
🌳 7 New Trees & Wood Types, with additional building and decorative blocks to discover
💎 Over 60 Unique New Materials
🛡️ Complete Armor, Weapon & Tool Sets
✨ Special Effects & Unique Powers
🏰 Bosses, Structures, and much more to explore
⚔️ A balance between classic materials and truly OP gear
Professionally designed mobs, bosses, decorative items, and crafting resources, with 3D modeling and smooth animations

🌌 NEW DIMENSIONS

🔥🌋 Inferno – a blazing and hostile realm full of secrets, challenges, and incredible loot.
⚫ Shadowrealm – a dark world crawling with danger.
🟩 Corrupted World – a twisted land consumed by corruption and chaos.
🟪 Voidream – an abstract, surreal realm similar to the End (beware the void!).
🟦 Glacium – a completely frozen world filled with mysteries.
🍭 Candyland – a surreal, colorful dimension packed with sweet surprises.
🏜️ Desertum – an ancient and scorching desert full of ruins and hidden treasures.

🌳 NEW NATURE

🌲 Discover brand-new trees and wood types — fresh resources for unique builds and advanced crafting!
Explore the various dimensions to find all wood types and building/decorative blocks scattered across the worlds.

💎 LEGENDARY MATERIALS

Over 60 completely new materials, each with its own full armor, sword, and tool set ⚒️🛡️.
Many come with special abilities, such as extreme resistance, super speed, night vision, slow falling, or elemental powers.

✨ Highlights include:
🩸🌑 BloodShadownite – the dark fusion of Bloodnite and Shadownite, reborn stronger than ever.
🌋🔥 Infernus – raw lava power forged into mighty gear.
☣️💀 Toxite – a deadly toxic core. Don’t hold the ingot too long… or perish!
🌀⚡ Volatarium – grants incredible speed and super jump.
☠️🔮 Necrothium – extremely powerful, infused with multiple dark abilities.
❄️🧊 Glacium – frozen essence crystallized into strength.
🪨⚒️ Magnus – heavy, dense, and mighty.
🌠💫 Starcrystal – pure starlight condensed into crystal.
🐉🔥 Drakonite – the ancient, blazing power of dragons.

🔷 CLASSIC & REVAMPED MATERIALS

Alongside the new materials, you’ll also find classic gems and metals, each with its own full set:

🔵 Cobalt
☢️ Uranium
🟦 Aetherium
🟨 Topaz
❤️ Ruby
💚 Emerald (Full Set)
💜 Amethyst (Full Set)
💠 Tourmaline
🩸 Crimsonite
⚙️ Steel
⚡ Nickel
🟢 Peridot
🩸 Bloodnite
🌑 Shadownite
🥉 Bronze
🔮 Void Gem

👉 With DimensionalRPG 2: New Horizon, Minecraft becomes a true mineral-based RPG, where every resource tells a story and every set unlocks new possibilities.
🌟 Are you ready to become a legend and defeat every threat standing in your way? 🌟
